messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High GPU queue growth detected in ap-southeast-1 (pool: gpool-8). queue_length increased from 120 -> 980 over 6m, autoscaler failed to scale due to soft limit. severity: P1. Paging oncall.

sara: i'm on it. grabbing logs and confirming impact. @leo can you check autoscaler controller events? tagging @maria for kv-cache health.

leo: looking. Autoscaler shows repeated ScaleUpRejected events:
```
ScaleUpRejected: pool=gpool-8 reason=vmQuotaExceeded soft_limit=24 current=24 requested=4
```
We hit our provider quota cap in ap-southeast-1. Scaling attempts returned 403/QuotaExceeded starting 2025-11-03T02:09:12Z.

maria: kv-cache hitrate steady at 72%. Not a cache storm. Latency for cold starts jumped ~220ms but not catastrophic. Most signal points to provisioning / quota.

alex: workaround suggestion: enable low-memory model variant fallback for < 1% of requests and force request shedding for non-critical tenants. I can flip routing to use redwood-lite-quantized for best-effort class.

tess: we have two customers with degraded latency — CS already filed 2 support tickets referencing 504s and higher latency. Not seeing errors in logs yet beyond timeouts. Prioritize customer-facing mitigation.

sara: mitigation plan: 1) enable model-variant fallback for best-effort route (alex) 2) throttle non-SLA tenants by reducing concurrency tokens (leo) 3) request provider quota emergency increase (maria). I'll coordinate comms.

leo: throttling rule pushed to rate-limiter:
```
route: tenant:non-sla concurrency:2 -> was 8
priority: low
```
Applying now.

incident-bot: Deploy bot: rate-limiter config v2025.11.03-async-7 applied successfully.

alex: routing switch done: 10% of incoming requests for route=/generate were pinned to redwood-lite-quantized, cascade fallback enabled. Monitoring latency.

maria: opened quota increase ticket with provider (ticket #AP-998241). Called on-call cloud rep; they marked it URGENT but ETA unknown (>= 1h). Also starting warm-up of any idle instances in other regions for cross-region fallback.

sara: observed queue length decreased to 420 after throttles & fallback. still higher than normal but stable. Customers 2/2 showing improvement in recent 3m.

tess: sending an interim note to affected customers: "we're mitigating capacity issues in ap-southeast-1 and routing some traffic to a reduced model to maintain availability; some requests may be slower or lower-fidelity". Will update once quota resolved.

leo: alert: autoscaler logs also show repeated API 429s from the provider when attempting new instance creation. Likely global rate limiting on provisioning. We're seeing partial success when trying from eu-west-1.

sara: decision: continue mitigations, do cross-region draining: start moving best-effort workloads to eu-west-1 gpool-3. This will be a gradual drain to avoid warmup storm. @alex schedule warm-up crests.

alex: warming up 3 c5-inference nodes in eu-west-1, preloading models, priming kv-cache. ETA ~ 7m.

maria: provider replied: quota increase approved +100 GPUs but it requires manual pool assignment; operations will finish in ~28m. Meanwhile rate limit window resets in 10m; we might get additional provisioning calls to succeed then.

sara: status update: queue length 180, errors dropping. Customer error rate reduced by ~86% vs peak. Keeping this thread open for handoff and post-incident actions. Next steps: continue to monitor until pool fully hydrated, then revert temporary throttles.

rio: support notes: logged customers affected, included mitigation steps + workaround. I'll keep tickets open for SLA credit assessment if latency SLA breached after postmortem.

sara: taking on-call handoff at 03:20 UTC to @leo for remediation progress; i'll be available for escalation. Please post updates and don't resolve until quota fully assigned and queue < 50 for 15m.

leo: acknowledged. I'll keep thread live and start a short RCA write-up draft.

sara: quick timeline for the postmortem draft (assignments):
- Incident timeline + root cause: leo
- Customer impact metrics + tickets: tess & rio
- Autoscaler and provider interaction logs: maria
- Mitigation steps and runbook gaps: alex
- Action items and owners: sara

incident-bot: NOTE: Reminder: create postmortem doc in /incidents/postmortems within 72 hours and assign severity classification.

leo: initial RCA notes: root cause = capacity exhaustion caused by an unexpected multi-tenant burst + provider quota cap + provisioning rate limits. Contributing factor = no cross-region automatic failover for low-priority pools; runbook requires manual cross-region drain.

sara: action items (short):
- (alex) add an automatic emergency fallback route to switch best-effort -> quantized variant with a single flag (due: 2025-11-10)
- (maria) automate quota check + pre-warm when projected demand > 75% for 5m (due: 2025-11-17)
- (leo) extend autoscaler backoff policy to tolerate provider 429s and retry with jitter (due: 2025-11-12)
- (tess & rio) customer comms template for capacity events (due: 2025-11-07)

sara: closing note: core customer-facing traffic restored to acceptable levels. Keeping the incident open for the handoff window (until pool assigned and stable). Thanks team for rapid coordination :heart:
